rows.text: The first partial bulletin of the second round of the PT's national elections, released at 12h on Monday 10 October 2005 (144,884 votes counted by 11h), gives Ricardo Berzoini 50.8% and Raul Pont 49.2% and says it is not yet possible to foresee who will be elected national president.
